summary: Frontend E2E (Playwright, desktop 1920x1080) of % discount + authorizer in POS Óptica (/optica/punto-venta) and POS Clínica (/punto-venta), plus hidden IVA in clinic POS. Core flows work: field visibility, discount math, blocking sale without authorizer, sale created with discount persisted, IVA hidden in UI/ticket/detail but stored in backend. Found 2 bugs in Óptica POS: (1) the error toast never shows because OpticaPOS has no <Toaster/> (the sale is blocked silently); (2) the discount % and authorizer are not cleared after a successful sale. There is also 1 business/UX concern in Clínica: Subtotal - Descuento != Total because hidden IVA is still added.

minor.issue: Response model omits descuento_monto (returned null in POST response), though it is stored in the DB (30). Not blocking.

ui_bugs.issue: With discount > 0 and no authorizer, Confirmar Venta correctly does NOT POST /api/optica/sales/v2, but the toast 'Indique quién autoriza el descuento' never appears. OpticaPOS imports toast from 'sonner' but renders no <Toaster/>, and there is no global Toaster in App.js. PuntoVenta.js renders its own Toaster. Every toast in Óptica POS (errors and success) is invisible, so the user just sees nothing happen.

After a successful sale, the cart is cleared but descuentoPorcentaje ('10') and descuentoAutoriza ('TEST_Gerente') stay in the inputs. The next sale silently inherits the 10% discount and the authorizer. Add setDescuentoPorcentaje('') and setDescuentoAutoriza('') there (or call limpiarCarrito). Clinic POS resets correctly.

issues: Because IVA is hidden but still added to the total, the visible math does not add up. Example: Subtotal Q300, Descuento -Q30, TOTAL Q302.40 (no discount: Subtotal Q300, TOTAL Q336). Cashiers and patients will see an unexplained difference. Confirm with the user whether prices should be treated as IVA-included (total = subtotal - discount, with IVA broken out internally) rather than IVA added on top.
The discount line shows the authorizer but not the % applied (e.g. 'Descuento 10%'). Optional.

action_items: OpticaPOS.js: render <Toaster position='top-right' richColors /> (as PuntoVenta does) or add a global Toaster so the 'Indique quién autoriza el descuento' error and other toasts are visible.
OpticaPOS.js procesarVenta success branch: reset descuentoPorcentaje and descuentoAutoriza after a sale.
Clarify the clinic IVA business rule: hidden IVA is still added on top, so Subtotal - Descuento != Total on screen, ticket and detail (300 - 30 -> 302.40).
critical_code_review_comments: Óptica and clínica both validate the authorizer on the frontend and the backend (backend returns 400). Good.
PuntoVenta.js and OpticaPOS.js are large files (~1950 and ~780 lines). Consider splitting.

The discount % input has no clamp in the UI (min/max are HTML-only). Values over 100 rely on backend validation (le=100) and will surface as an error toast. In Óptica that toast is invisible because of the Toaster bug.
